description: Mobilités alternatives, SUR et HORS voirie 14nov2019 Bordeaux Métropole is a dataset listed in DataHub Métropole de Bordeaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by DataHub Métropole de Bordeaux. Le schéma liste -les aires de covoiturages de Bordeaux Métropole, situées sur voirie (gratuites, sur voirie ou bien sur des parkings de supermarchés) ou bien dans les parcs-relais de Bordeaux Métropole (accès prix d'un ticket de tram à valider dans la journée) -les places d'autopartages en 1919, Citiz et Bluecub -les bornes électriques sur domaine ... Coverage: Bordeaux Métropole. The portal files it under Transports/mobilité. The portal shows 224 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2019-11-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datahub-bordeaux-metropole-fr-portal.
